newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seyang unit defaults debt repayment.
newsitem.headline: Seyang unit defaults debt repayment.

text.p: South Korea's Seyang Shipping Co Ltd said on Friday its unlisted affiliate Daedong Shipbuilding Industry Co has defaulted on paying back promissory notes.
Daedong failed to honour 2.03 billion won worth of notes on Friday, after having defaulted on another 8.7 billion won worth of notes on Thursday, Seyang said in a statement.
Seyang owns 69.91 percent of Daedong's paid-up capital of 14.13 billion won, it said.
Daedong is a medium-sized shipbuilding and ship repair company based in South Korea's southeastern city of Chinhae.
Seyang, which is specialising in shipping lumber into South Korea from Asian nations, itself is considering filing for court receivership due to international financial trouble.
It earlier said the trouble stemmed from the fact that its largest shareholder was a brother-in-law of the founder of the debt-ridden Hanbo Group.
The Hanbo Group is in crisis after its flagship, Hanbo Steel Co, defaulted debt repayments and filed for court receivership.
